spectral_reason: H is positive definite because (I-Pi)/8 is PSD and its constant kernel intersects the kernel of diag(a) only at zero. After weighted conjugation it is diag(1/8+a_i)-(1/8)sqrt(pi)sqrt(pi)^T. Strict rank-one interlacing gives simple eigenvalues in (0,1/8), (1/8,9/64), and (9/64,5/32), all different from 7/8. Thus the fine square has four distinct positive centered values: 49/64 and these three eigenvalue squares.
zero_parameter_case: At a=0 the centered square values are 49/64 (multiplicity 2), 1/64 (multiplicity 2), and 0 (multiplicity 1). This is three centered values, not an entire-centered-space two-value case.
sign_obstruction: All three off-diagonal H^2 entries are strictly negative, so their triangle product is negative and no diagonal sign gauge can make H^2 entrywise nonnegative.
compensation_scope: At the recorded gamma=1/4 tuple, p=1/6<1/4 and gamma*max_A=157/128>1. These fail the stated older density and maximum-kernel tests only; no claim about every prior local neighborhood.
normalization: Every composition used the original pi or the original fine masses pi_i/2; no measure substitution.
